description: This test ensures users can log in using their GitHub account and access the application dashboard upon successful authentication.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Locate and click on the GitHub login button.
Verify the redirection to the GitHub OAuth authentication page.
Enter valid GitHub credentials and authorize access.
Verify the redirection back to the Roost.ai platform.
Check if the user is successfully logged in and redirected to the primary dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai.
expected_results: User is redirected to the GitHub OAuth page.
User successfully logs in using their GitHub credentials.
User is redirected back to the Roost.ai dashboard.
User sees the primary application dashboard with no errors.
edge_cases: Network issue during redirection to the GitHub OAuth page.
User revokes permissions on the GitHub consent screen.
User tries to log in with an account not linked to Roost.ai.
Session timeout during the GitHub login process.
data_requirements: User's GitHub account linked to Roost.ai.
OAuth client ID and secret configured correctly.
Redirect URI properly set up in the GitHub OAuth console.
dependencies: Roost.ai backend configured to handle GitHub login.
Browser with cookies and JavaScript enabled.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect from GitHub OAuth back to Roost.ai.
Page load time for the primary dashboard after login.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the GitHub login button is keyboard-navigable.
Provide alternative text for visually impaired users.
Ensure focus is properly managed during redirection.
